script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Saying Timothy does not stand over the younger men adds a conclusion about his position that the text does not give.
The joke about a cousin who only shows up for food relies on a family stereotype.
The explanation is flat and largely repeats that pleasing is the word in the passage.
Saying nobody else is left to lean on, so she leans on God, adds a reason for her hope that Paul does not give.
The statement that God is always there is a Bible claim beyond this passage and needs a reference.
Saying Paul wants Timothy to see the difference adds an unstated intention.
The explanation is flat and repeats the age without adding much explanation or personality.
Saying good works are not what the younger widows are known for makes a claim about them that the passage does not make.
The explanation makes verse 15 the reason Paul is careful in everything he just said, extending the stated reason beyond the text.
Saying there is no joke to make comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
